user.title: T+A device
user.description:
Enter the IP address or host name of your T+A HV series streamer (for example a PSD 3100 HV, MP 3100 HV or PA 3100 HV). It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Reserve the address in your router so it does not change.

zeroconf_confirm.title: T+A device found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add {name} ({model}) at {host}?

Tip: reserve {host} for the device in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). If the address changes, Home Assistant finds the device again, but only while it is on the network.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

reconfigure.title: Change the device address
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new address of the device.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

error.cannot_connect: The device did not answer. Check the address and that it is powered at the mains (standby is fine).
error.not_ta: A device answered, but it is not a T+A streaming device.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.not_ta: The discovered device is not a T+A streaming device.
abort.wrong_device: A different device answers at this address.

init.title: T+A options

data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets the volume above this, so a slipped slider cannot drive the system to full power. The device's own remote and knob are not limited.

init.description: Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

not_responding.message: The device at {host} is not responding. It is switched off at the mains or disconnected; turn it on at the device.

turned_off.message: The device is turned off. Turn it on first.

unknown_source.message: This device has no input or radio favourite called {source}.

address_changed.title: {name} has a new IP address
address_changed.description:
The device moved from {old_host} to {new_host}. Home Assistant has switched to the new address.

To stop this from happening, reserve {new_host} for the device in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). Then ignore or dismiss this message.
